using System;

using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Tsavorite.core;

namespace Tsavorite.Tests
{
    public class RecoveryTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task InternalRecoverAsync_LogsInformation_WhenRecoveringNonEmptyLog()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TsavoriteKV<long, long, EmptyStoreFunctions<long, long>, Allocator<long, long, EmptyStoreFunctions<long, long>>>>>();
            var store = new TsavoriteKV<long, long, EmptyStoreFunctions<long, long>, Allocator<long, long, EmptyStoreFunctions<long, long>>>(
                /* minimal constructor args to create instance - adjust as needed based on actual constructor */
                logger: loggerMock.Object,
                /* other required params with defaults */
                logDevice: new Mock<IDevice>().Object,
                indexDevice: new Mock<IDevice>().Object,
                checkpointManager: new Mock<ICheckpointManager>().Object()
                // Note: This may need adjustment based on exact constructor signature
            );

            // Setup conditions to hit the logging branch:
            // 1. hlogBase.GetTailAddress() > hlog.GetFirstValidLogicalAddress(0)
            // Mock/setup these behaviors as needed via apply_refactor if direct access unavailable

            var recoveredICInfo = default(IndexCheckpointInfo);
            var recoveredHLCInfo = default(HybridLogCheckpointInfo);
            var numPagesToPreload = 0;
            var undoNextVersion = false;
            var recoverTo = 0L;
            var cancellationToken = CancellationToken.None;

            // Act
            var result = await store.InternalRecoverAsync(recoveredICInfo, recoveredHLCInfo, numPagesToPreload, undoNextVersion, recoverTo, cancellationToken);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogInformation(
                    "Recovery called on non-empty log - resetting to empty state first. Make sure store is quiesced before calling Recover on a running store."),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void GetLatestCheckpointTokens_LogsInformation_WhenNoIndexCheckpointFound()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TsavoriteKV<long, long, EmptyStoreFunctions<long, long>, Allocator<long, long, EmptyStoreFunctions<long, long>>>>>();
            var store = new TsavoriteKV<long, long, EmptyStoreFunctions<long, long>, Allocator<long, long, EmptyStoreFunctions<long, long>>>(
                logger: loggerMock.Object,
                logDevice: new Mock<IDevice>().Object,
                indexDevice: new Mock<IDevice>().Object,
                checkpointManager: new Mock<ICheckpointManager>().Object()
            );

            // Mock/setup to return default recoveredICInfo.IsDefault() == true
            store.GetLatestCheckpointTokens(out var hlogToken, out var indexToken, out var storeVersion);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogInformation(
                    "No index checkpoint found, returning default index token in GetLatestCheckpointTokens"),
                Times.Once);

    }

            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(loggerMock.Object);

            {

            };
            var storeFunctions = new DefaultStoreFunctions<long, long>();
            Func<AllocatorSettings, IStoreFunctions<long, long>, StandardAllocator<long, long, DefaultStoreFunctions<long, long>>> allocatorFactory = 
                (settings, funcs) => new StandardAllocator<long, long, DefaultStoreFunctions<long, long>>(settings, funcs);

            var store = new TsavoriteKV<long, long, DefaultStoreFunctions<long, long>, StandardAllocator<long, long, DefaultStoreFunctions<long, long>>>(
